name: Snowflake
model: Tables of typed columns plus semi-structured VARIANT (JSON), SQL; cloud data warehouse with separate virtual warehouses for compute
engine_note: Immutable compressed columnar micro-partitions in cloud object storage; compute clusters (virtual warehouses) read them; hybrid tables add a row store
consistency: Multi-statement, multi-table transactions; READ COMMITTED is the only isolation level (each statement sees data committed before it began, so two reads in one transaction can differ). AUTOCOMMIT is on by default.
scaling: Separated storage and compute: add or resize virtual warehouses (multi-cluster for concurrency), storage grows in object storage automatically.
managed: Snowflake on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
version_note: Weekly release 10.35 rolled out 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-30 (new ACCOUNT_USAGE.STREAMS view); 10.36 in preview.
reach: Reach for it when several teams need one governed SQL warehouse, with separate compute per team and no cluster tuning, on any of the three clouds.
avoid: Avoid as an app's live database: per-request latency and per-second warehouse billing suit batch analytics, not thousands of small queries.
escape: analytics for many teams on shared data, each with its own compute, without loading the app database
chat: Warehouse copy of chats, messages and usage events for analytics, finance and cohort reports.
notes: Isolation and autocommit quoted from the transactions page (fetched 2026-10-04). Snowflake ships weekly numbered releases rather than downloadable versions. Engine and scaling URLs are the standard docs pages, not re-fetched in this pass.
